findings.title: Outer replacement can be cleaned by Theme before T10 observes it
evidence: settings-local-controls-acceptance.mjs:1073 performs outer reload after capture; rerun is invoked later at1114.
rerunGuestSettingsAfterExtensionReload loops GUEST_PREFERENCES order T04 then T10 at333; first carried T10 comparison is only inside later branch runGuestModeRefusalCase after another reload.
T04 restoreBaseline callback at470-479 invokes restoreGuestPreferenceBaseline; original absent container is removed at settings-guest-preference-batch.mjs:709.

Thus a new defaultPermissionMode shadow materialized by outer replacement can be erased by T04 cleanup before T10 comparison. T04 may record its own presence mismatch, but T10 can still receive false full-reload/no-shadow pass.
New test mutates detached states.T10.shadowFootprint; Theme raw storage deletion does not alter that fixture, so it does not exercise real shared-store coupling.
findings.required_fix: Check immutable carried T10 footprint immediately on rerun entry, before any T04 choice/restoration; preserve the original expectation. Ensure every replacement credited to T10 is observed before sibling mutation/cleanup. Use shared raw storage in regression: seed settings mode after outer replacement, destructive absent Theme restoration would erase it, require T10 failure and zero sibling restoration/choice effects before detection.
